description: Aggregate statistics on how the Danish sportsbook Oddset prices football and tennis vs the de-vigged Pinnacle closing price (CLV gap), bookmaker margins, and late-vs-early price drift, by sport, league, market and hours-before-kickoff bucket. Every row is a mean/median/95% CI over >= 20 events; no raw odds. Period 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-07. Headline: mean CLV -8.4%. CLV is not profit; no betting tips. Call with summary=true for the headline only.

summary.description: Return the headline summary instead of rows.

name: betting_market_efficiency
title: Betting market efficiency (Oddset vs sharp market, aggregates)

description: Look up one company by its official identifier: FR SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14), NO organisasjonsnummer (9 digits), FI Y-tunnus (1234567-8), US CIK or stock ticker. The country can be given, or prefixed in the id (e.g. NO:923609016); otherwise the id is routed by check-digit validation. Includes officers and filings by default.

id.description: Registry identifier, ticker for US, or prefixed form like FR:552032534.

name: get_company
title: Get one company by registry identifier

description: Search companies by name in official business registers: France (INSEE Sirene / RNE), Norway (Brønnøysund), Finland (PRH/YTJ) and US SEC EDGAR filers. Returns normalized records (registry id, legal name, legal form, status, incorporation date, address, industry code, website, VAT where published).

country.description: fr, no, fi, us, a comma-separated list, or all (default all).

filings.description: Include filings (NO annual accounts, US SEC filings).

query.description: Company name (or part of it) to search for.
